parole.significato: lobster (a crustacean of the Nephropidae, or Homaridae, family)
parole.testo: From Middle French homard, hommars, houmar (all 16th c.), probably via Middle Low German hummer from Old Norse humarr (“lobster”), from Proto-Germanic *humaraz.
